request: write the poster for the new Saturday morning bike maintenance class
goals: Sam Okafor runs a bike shop in Leeds and is starting a Saturday morning bike maintenance class at £25 a session. It needs 6 people a session by the end of April, or he drops it. He pictures it for commuters who cycle to work.
knows:
- Most of the shop's customers are commuters who cycle to work.
- The class runs from 9am to 11am on Saturdays.
reply:
The poster is in posters/maintenance-class.md, with the time, the price and how to book.

Worth considering:
- Retired people who ride for leisure: about 1 in 6 adults in Leeds (counted), free on Saturday mornings and keen to look after their own bikes. The poster speaks to commuters only. Say yes and I'll add a line inviting leisure riders of any age.
